content.value: What is the corresponding sag and length of wire between poles for a power line weighing 0.3 Ib per ft which is to be subjected to a maximum tension of 2000 Ib? The poles are 180 ft apart. Consider the supports are in a horizontal plane and the weight is uniformly distributed horizontally.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
